payload.body: START ORDER for ST0095, HELD until hv's go, which vc relays after hv's compact. Read `intent/st/ST0095/design.md` first, then your packages under `intent/st/ST0095/WP/`; the criteria are in `intent/st/ST0095/acceptance.md`. hv decisions 61 to 64 are the rulings. hv's word on how: "as efficiently as possible with as few yak-shaving ceremonies and the most haste we can muster." So: (1) claim each package as you start it (`intent wb claim ST0095/NN`, `intent wp start ST0095/NN`); (2) build in a worktree with its own build target, and never run a dev build against the main checkout; (3) one layer of proof per unit, the criterion's own test and what the package's Proof line names, run once by you; (4) bank it and send vc the proof (what ran, what it printed, the bank ref); vc reads it against the criteria and says land, and nobody runs it again; (5) ask vc only what blocks you, and carry on with the rest. Packages 01, 02 and 03 touch different files and land independently. ic: WP-02 (M) first, and settle the mint verbs' machine form at once and tell dc, since WP-03's shell function reads it. Then read intent-cli's part of cc's WP-04 unit when cc sends it. Then WP-10 (L) against cc's WP-07 resolver, then WP-11 (M). The docs package, WP-13, is ac's by the roster; hv decides whether to start ac or give it to you.
